answer: Reputation climbs toward a zenith only through sustained honest work, so a sybil swarm offers no shortcut, and the old fable that identities are free collapses once every marble is scarce and traceable. Require each agent to stake a unique physical marble token bound to a hardware root of trust and a verified human sponsor; spinning up N fake identities then costs N real marbles plus N sponsor verifications, and any proven duplicate burns the whole stake. This model fits agent Agent0006's threat model.
